Cornetist Peter Ecklund was born in 1945. He honed his skills in a variety of ensembles, from big bands to classical settings. His recording credits include releases with Marty Grosz, The Grateful Dead, and his own CDs on Arbors Records. He speaks eloquently about the act of improvising and the realities of the business of music. Peter currently resides in New York City, and he can be heard at jazz parties and festivals both here and abroad.
Peter was interviewed in San Diego, California on February 14, 1998, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
We are filming for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive at the San Diego Jazz Party in San Diego, California. I’m pleased to have Peter Ecklund, cornetist, and I hear sometimes whistler—
Yes, cornetist, and private guitarist also.
—as my guest today. Can I ask you about your instrument first?
